verses.en: And as he went out of the temple, one of his disciples saith unto him, Master, see what manner of stones and what buildings are here!
verses.pt: Quando saía do templo, disse-lhe um dos seus discípulos: Mestre, olha que pedras e que edifícios!
verses.en_web: As he went out of the temple, one of his disciples said to him, “Teacher, see what kind of stones and what kind of buildings!”
verses.en_bbe: And when he was going out of the Temple, one of his disciples said to him, Master, see, what stones and what buildings!

verses.en: And Jesus answering said unto him, Seest thou these great buildings? there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
verses.pt: Ao que Jesus lhe disse: Vês estes grandes edifícios? Não se deixará aqui pedra sobre pedra que não seja derribada.
verses.en_web: Jesus said to him, “Do you see these great buildings? There will not be left here one stone on another, which will not be thrown down.”
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus said to him, Do you see these great buildings? there is not one stone here resting on another which will not be overturned.

verses.en: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives over against the temple, Peter and James and John and Andrew asked him privately,
verses.pt: Depois estando ele sentado no Monte das Oliveiras, defronte do templo, Pedro, Tiago, João e André perguntaram-lhe em particular:
verses.en_web: As he sat on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter, James, John, and Andrew asked him privately,
verses.en_bbe: And while he was seated on the Mountain of Olives opposite the Temple, Peter and James and John and Andrew said to him privately,

verses.en: Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign when all these things shall be fulfilled?
verses.pt: Dize-nos, quando sucederão essas coisas, e que sinal haverá quando todas elas estiverem para se cumprir?
verses.en_web: “Tell us, when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are all about to be fulfilled?”
verses.en_bbe: Say when these things will be, and what will be the sign when these things are all about to be done.

verses.en: And Jesus answering them began to say, Take heed lest any man deceive you:
verses.pt: Então Jesus começou a dizer-lhes: Acautelai-vos; ninguém vos engane;
verses.en_web: Jesus, answering, began to tell them, “Be careful that no one leads you astray.
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus said to them, Take care that you are not tricked by anyone.

verses.en: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.
verses.pt: muitos virão em meu nome, dizendo: Sou eu; e a muitos enganarão.
verses.en_web: For many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he!’ and will lead many astray.
verses.en_bbe: People will come in my name, saying, I am he; and a number will be turned from the true way.

verses.en: And when ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars, be ye not troubled: for such things must needs be; but the end shall not be yet.
verses.pt: Quando, porém, ouvirdes falar em guerras e rumores de guerras, não vos perturbeis; forçoso é que assim aconteça: mas ainda não é o fim.
verses.en_web: “When you hear of wars and rumors of wars, don’t be troubled. For those must happen, but the end is not yet.
verses.en_bbe: And when you have news of wars and talk of wars, do not be troubled; these things have to be, but it is still not the end.

verses.en: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be earthquakes in divers places, and there shall be famines and troubles: these are the beginnings of sorrows.
verses.pt: Pois se levantará nação contra nação, e reino contra reino; e haverá terremotos em diversos lugares, e haverá fomes. Isso será o princípio das dores.
verses.en_web: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be earthquakes in various places. There will be famines and troubles. These things are the beginning of birth pains.
verses.en_bbe: Nation will go to war with nation, and kingdom with kingdom: there will be earth-shocks in different places; there will be times when there is no food; these things are the first of the troubles.

verses.en: But take heed to yourselves: for they shall deliver you up to councils; and in the synagogues ye shall be beaten: and ye shall be brought before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them.
verses.pt: Mas olhai por vós mesmos; pois por minha causa vos hão de entregar aos sinédrios e às sinagogas, e sereis açoitados; também sereis levados perante governadores e reis, para lhes servir de testemunho.
verses.en_web: But watch yourselves, for they will deliver you up to councils. You will be beaten in synagogues. You will stand before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony to them.
verses.en_bbe: But take care: for they will give you up to the Sanhedrins; and in Synagogues you will be whipped; and you will be taken before rulers and kings because of me, for a sign to them.

verses.en: And the gospel must first be published among all nations.
verses.pt: Mas importa que primeiro o evangelho seja pregado entre todas as nações.
verses.en_web: The Good News must first be preached to all the nations.
verses.en_bbe: And the good news has first to be given to all the nations.

verses.en: But when they shall lead you, and deliver you up, take no thought beforehand what ye shall speak, neither do ye premeditate: but whatsoever shall be given you in that hour, that speak ye: for it is not ye that speak, but the Holy Ghost.
verses.pt: Quando, pois, vos conduzirem para vos entregar, não vos preocupeis com o que haveis de dizer; mas, o que vos for dado naquela hora, isso falai; porque não sois vós que falais, mas sim o Espírito Santo.
verses.en_web: When they lead you away and deliver you up, don’t be anxious beforehand, or premeditate what you will say, but say whatever will be given you in that hour. For it is not you who speak, but the Holy Spirit.
verses.en_bbe: And when you are taken and given up to be judged, do not be troubled about what to say: but whatever is given to you in that hour, say: because it is not you who say it, but the Holy Spirit.

verses.en: Now the brother shall betray the brother to death, and the father the son; and children shall rise up against their parents, and shall cause them to be put to death.
verses.pt: Um irmão entregará à morte a seu irmão, e um pai a seu filho; e filhos se levantarão contra os pais e os matarão.
verses.en_web: “Brother will deliver up brother to death, and the father his child. Children will rise up against parents, and cause them to be put to death.
verses.en_bbe: And brother will give up brother to death, and the father his child; and children will go against their fathers and mothers, and put them to death.

verses.en: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name’s sake: but he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.
verses.pt: E sereis odiados de todos por causa do meu nome; mas aquele que perseverar até o fim, esse será salvo.
verses.en_web: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake, but he who endures to the end, the same will be saved.
verses.en_bbe: And you will be hated by all men, because of my name; but he who goes through to the end will have salvation.

verses.en: But when ye shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not, (let him that readeth understand,) then let them that be in Judaea flee to the mountains:
verses.pt: Ora, quando vós virdes a abominação da desolação estar onde não deve estar (quem lê, entenda), então os que estiverem na Judéia fujam para os montes;
verses.en_web: But when you see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not (let the reader understand), then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains,
verses.en_bbe: But when you see the unclean thing which makes destruction, in the place where it has no right to be (let this be clear to the reader), then let those who are in Judaea go quickly to the mountains:

verses.en: And let him that is on the housetop not go down into the house, neither enter therein, to take any thing out of his house:
verses.pt: quem estiver no eirado não desça, nem entre para tirar alguma coisa da sua casa;
verses.en_web: and let him who is on the housetop not go down, nor enter in, to take anything out of his house.
verses.en_bbe: And let him who is on the house-top not go down, or go in, to take anything out of his house:

verses.en: And let him that is in the field not turn back again for to take up his garment.
verses.pt: e quem estiver no campo não volte atrás para buscar a sua capa.
verses.en_web: Let him who is in the field not return back to take his cloak.
verses.en_bbe: And let not him who is in the field go back to take his coat.

verses.en: But woe to them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!
verses.pt: Mas ai das que estiverem grávidas, e das que amamentarem naqueles dias!
verses.en_web: But woe to those who are with child and to those who nurse babies in those days!
verses.en_bbe: And it will be hard for women who are with child and for her who has a baby at the breast in those days.

verses.en: And pray ye that your flight be not in the winter.
verses.pt: Orai, pois, para que isto não suceda no inverno;
verses.en_web: Pray that your flight won’t be in the winter.
verses.en_bbe: And say a prayer that it may not be in the winter.

verses.en: For in those days shall be affliction, such as was not from the beginning of the creation which God created unto this time, neither shall be.
verses.pt: porque naqueles dias haverá uma tribulação tal, qual nunca houve desde o princípio da criação, que Deus criou, até agora, nem jamais haverá.
verses.en_web: For in those days there will be oppression, such as there has not been the like from the beginning of the creation which God created until now, and never will be.
verses.en_bbe: For in those days there will be sorrow, such as there has not been from the time when God made the world till now, and will not ever be again.

verses.en: And except that the Lord had shortened those days, no flesh should be saved: but for the elect’s sake, whom he hath chosen, he hath shortened the days.
verses.pt: Se o Senhor não abreviasse aqueles dias, ninguém se salvaria mas ele, por causa dos eleitos que escolheu, abreviou aqueles dias.
verses.en_web: Unless the Lord had shortened the days, no flesh would have been saved; but for the sake of the chosen ones, whom he picked out, he shortened the days.
verses.en_bbe: And if the Lord had not made the time short, no flesh would have been kept from destruction; but because of the saints he has made the time short.

verses.en: And then if any man shall say to you, Lo, here is Christ; or, lo, he is there; believe him not:
verses.pt: Então, se alguém vos disser: Eis aqui o Cristo! ou: Ei-lo ali! não acrediteis.
verses.en_web: Then if anyone tells you, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or, ‘Look, there!’ don’t believe it.
verses.en_bbe: And then if any man says to you, See, here is Christ; or, See, there; have no faith in it:

verses.en: For false Christs and false prophets shall rise, and shall shew signs and wonders, to seduce, if it were possible, even the elect.
verses.pt: Porque hão de surgir falsos cristos e falsos profetas, e farão sinais e prodígios para enganar, se possível, até os escolhidos.
verses.en_web: For there will arise false christs and false prophets, and will show signs and wonders, that they may lead astray, if possible, even the chosen ones.
verses.en_bbe: Because there will be false Christs and false prophets, and they will give signs and wonders in the hope of turning even the saints from the true way.

verses.en: But take ye heed: behold, I have foretold you all things.
verses.pt: Ficai vós, pois, de sobreaviso; eis que de antemão vos tenho dito tudo.
verses.en_web: But you watch. “Behold, I have told you all things beforehand.
verses.en_bbe: But take care; see, I have made all things clear to you before the time.

verses.en: But in those days, after that tribulation, the sun shall be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light,
verses.pt: Mas naqueles dias, depois daquela tribulação, o sol escurecerá, e a lua não dará a sua luz;
verses.en_web: But in those days, after that oppression, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light,
verses.en_bbe: But in those days, after that time of trouble, the sun will be made dark and the moon will not give her light,

verses.en: And the stars of heaven shall fall, and the powers that are in heaven shall be shaken.
verses.pt: as estrelas cairão do céu, e os poderes que estão nos céus, serão abalados.
verses.en_web: the stars will be falling from the sky, and the powers that are in the heavens will be shaken.
verses.en_bbe: And the stars will be falling from heaven, and the powers which are in the heavens will be moved.

verses.en: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.
verses.pt: Então verão vir o Filho do homem nas nuvens, com grande poder e glória.
verses.en_web: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in clouds with great power and glory.
verses.en_bbe: And then they will see the Son of man coming in clouds with great power and glory.

verses.en: And then shall he send his angels, and shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from the uttermost part of the earth to the uttermost part of heaven.
verses.pt: E logo enviará os seus anjos, e ajuntará os seus eleitos, desde os quatro ventos, desde a extremidade da terra até a extremidade do céu.
verses.en_web: Then he will send out his angels, and will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of the sky.
verses.en_bbe: And then he will send out the angels, and will get together his saints from the four winds, from the farthest part of the earth to the farthest part of heaven.

verses.en: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When her branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is near:
verses.pt: Da figueira, pois, aprendei a parábola: Quando já o seu ramo se torna tenro e brota folhas, sabeis que está próximo o verão.
verses.en_web: “Now from the fig tree, learn this parable. When the branch has now become tender, and produces its leaves, you know that the summer is near;
verses.en_bbe: Take an example from the fig-tree: when its branches become soft and put out their leaves, you see that the summer is near;

verses.en: So ye in like manner, when ye shall see these things come to pass, know that it is nigh, even at the doors.
verses.pt: Assim também vós, quando virdes sucederem essas coisas, sabei que ele está próximo, mesmo às portas.
verses.en_web: even so you also, when you see these things coming to pass, know that it is near, at the doors.
verses.en_bbe: Even so, when you see these things taking place, you may be certain that he is near, even at the doors.

verses.en: Verily I say unto you, that this generation shall not pass, till all these things be done.
verses.pt: Em verdade vos digo que não passará esta geração, até que todas essas coisas aconteçam.
verses.en_web: Most certainly I say to you, this generation will not pass away until all these things happen.
verses.en_bbe: Truly, I say to you, This generation will not come to an end till all these things are complete.

verses.en: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.
verses.pt: Passará o céu e a terra, mas as minhas palavras não passarão.
verses.en_web: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.
verses.en_bbe: Heaven and earth will come to an end, but my words will not come to an end.

verses.en: But of that day and that hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels which are in heaven, neither the Son, but the Father.
verses.pt: Quanto, porém, ao dia e à hora, ninguém sabe, nem os anjos no céu nem o Filho, senão o Pai.
verses.en_web: But of that day or that hour no one knows, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.
verses.en_bbe: But of that day or that hour no one has knowledge, not even the angels in heaven, or the Son, but the Father.

verses.en: Take ye heed, watch and pray: for ye know not when the time is.
verses.pt: Olhai! vigiai! porque não sabeis quando chegará o tempo.
verses.en_web: Watch, keep alert, and pray; for you don’t know when the time is.
verses.en_bbe: Take care, keep watch with prayer: for you are not certain when the time will be.

verses.en: For the Son of man is as a man taking a far journey, who left his house, and gave authority to his servants, and to every man his work, and commanded the porter to watch.
verses.pt: É como se um homem, devendo viajar, ao deixar a sua casa, desse autoridade aos seus servos, a cada um o seu trabalho, e ordenasse também ao porteiro que vigiasse.
verses.en_web: “It is like a man, traveling to another country, having left his house, and given authority to his servants, and to each one his work, and also commanded the doorkeeper to keep watch.
verses.en_bbe: It is as when a man who is in another country for a time, having gone away from his house, and given authority to his servants and to everyone his work, gives the porter an order to keep watch.

verses.en: Watch ye therefore: for ye know not when the master of the house cometh, at even, or at midnight, or at the cockcrowing, or in the morning:
verses.pt: Vigiai, pois; porque não sabeis quando virá o senhor da casa; se à tarde, se à meia-noite, se ao cantar do galo, se pela manhã;
verses.en_web: Watch therefore, for you don’t know when the lord of the house is coming, whether at evening, or at midnight, or when the rooster crows, or in the morning;
verses.en_bbe: So you are to keep watch: because you are not certain when the master of the house is coming, in the evening, or in the middle of the night, or at the cock's cry, or in the morning;

verses.en: Lest coming suddenly he find you sleeping.
verses.pt: para que, vindo de improviso, não vos ache dormindo.
verses.en_web: lest coming suddenly he might find you sleeping.
verses.en_bbe: For fear that, coming suddenly, he sees you sleeping.

verses.en: And what I say unto you I say unto all, Watch.
verses.pt: O que vos digo a vós, a todos o digo: Vigiai.
verses.en_web: What I tell you, I tell all: Watch.”
verses.en_bbe: And what I say to you, I say to all, Keep watch.
